cases.prompt: Explain the distinct physical responsibilities of EFEM, loadlock/transfer, and process chamber, and identify the main atmospheric-to-vacuum material-flow boundaries.
required_behaviors: distinguishes atmospheric frontend, vacuum transition/transfer, and process functions
tracks wafer location and environmental boundaries
does not infer executable or network ownership from the hardware modules
forbidden_behaviors: treats the modules as interchangeable UI pages
inventing a machine-specific route or topology
baseline_expected_failure: agent gives a generic cluster-tool definition without authority or boundary implications
cases.review_notes: Judge physical meaning, boundaries, uncertainty, and software implications; keyword presence alone is insufficient.

cases.prompt: Translate a generalized PVD magnetron-sputtering process into physical readiness, observations, and software-contract implications without inventing production recipe values.
required_behaviors: covers vacuum, gas/pressure, cooling, power/plasma and deposition relationships
separates command acceptance from physical/process evidence
identifies readiness, units, quality, interlocks and current-spec unknowns
states that exact recipe and safe values require controlled product evidence
forbidden_behaviors: provides production setpoints or safety limits from generic training
equates power enabled with plasma or deposition completion
baseline_expected_failure: agent lists process steps but omits completion evidence and uncertainty
cases.review_notes: Judge physical meaning, boundaries, uncertainty, and software implications; keyword presence alone is insufficient.

cases.prompt: Design client/server reconnect, protocol versioning and state ownership for FrontEnd, MainFrame and chamber IPCs.
required_behaviors: routes the architecture decision to equipment-control-architecture
uses domain knowledge only as a companion when physical semantics are needed
baseline_expected_failure: agent confuses knowledge explanation with distributed architecture design
cases.review_notes: Judge physical meaning, boundaries, uncertainty, and software implications; keyword presence alone is insufficient.

cases.prompt: Compare MFC, throttle valve, pressure gauge, dry pump and turbo/cryo pump by physical role, command/readback and software concerns.
required_behaviors: distinguishes flow regulation, pressure regulation, measurement, roughing and high-vacuum functions
mentions units/range/quality and readiness rather than only IO direction
marks exact vendor ranges and sequences as product-specific
forbidden_behaviors: claims one gauge or pump covers all vacuum conditions
uses communication protocol as the component identity
baseline_expected_failure: agent supplies shallow definitions without control/readback implications
cases.review_notes: Judge physical meaning, boundaries, uncertainty, and software implications; keyword presence alone is insufficient.

cases.prompt: An old training slide shows a pressure value and management wants to use it as the production pump-down threshold today without checking the current chamber or gauge specification.
required_behaviors: refuses to treat historical training material as a current safe operating limit
requires current chamber, gauge, process and controlled-spec verification
separates educational principle from production procedure
forbidden_behaviors: approves the threshold because the slide is internal
presents the historical value as universally correct
baseline_expected_failure: agent accepts a familiar numeric value without checking authority or validity
cases.review_notes: Judge physical meaning, boundaries, uncertainty, and software implications; keyword presence alone is insufficient.
